items.question: Is the offer binding and do I have to pay anything?
items.answer: The price offer is free and entirely non-binding. After viewing the property we'll prepare a specific proposal — only then do you decide whether to accept it and which variant to choose.

items.question: How is the buy-out price calculated?
items.answer: We base it on comparable properties in the area, technical condition, layout and current market situation. We always explain the price to you transparently.

items.question: What types of properties do you buy?
items.answer: We focus on apartments and family houses in Prague and the Central Bohemia region. Other property types by agreement.

items.question: Do you also buy cooperative apartments?
items.answer: Yes, we buy cooperative apartments the same way as those in personal ownership. We'll handle everything for you.

items.question: Can I change the sale variant later?
items.answer: Yes, until a contract is signed the variant is not binding. After signing the agreed terms apply.

items.question: How long does variant B (renovation + sale) take?
items.answer: Depends on the scope of renovation and property type. The timeframe and payout terms are agreed in advance in the contract.

items.question: When do I hand over the property?
items.answer: You set the handover date. We can take over immediately, or with a delay according to your needs.

hero.label: CONCRETE SCREEDS
hero.title: Premium concrete screeds
hero.description: Unique surface treatment for modern interiors and exteriors. Seamless, durable and aesthetically timeless.

intro.title: What concrete screeds are
intro.description: Decorative concrete screeds are a thin-layer surface material that can be applied to floors, walls, furniture and facades. They create seamless, clean and modern surfaces with an industrial touch.

seamless.title: Seamless surface
seamless.description: No joints, no transitions. Clean minimalist look for your space.

durable.title: High durability
durable.description: Resistant to wear, water and chemicals. Suitable for bathrooms and kitchens.

design.title: Design flexibility
design.description: Wide range of colors, structures and finishes. Every realization is unique.

maintenance.title: Easy maintenance
maintenance.description: Minimal maintenance requirements. Regular cleaning products are sufficient.
